page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Two medallion portraits with legends at the top of the text block, below them one column of running text with two entries (Themistocles, Stesilea). No marginal notes, no footnotes. Signature at lower right.

main_text.p: THEMISTOCLES, Atheniensium dux fortissimus ac prudentissimus,ingenti gloriæ studio tenebatur.hic fusis,fugatísque Persis,atq; eorum Rege Xerxe,Athenas reædificauit, muro cinxit, Pyreúmque ciuitati iunxit,anno mundi 3492. à Christo nato 470. nec tamen inuidia caruit, dicere solitus se neque honoribus ab Atheniensibus affici,neq; apud eos in admiratione esse,sed procella vexatos imminente periculo, ad se veluti platanû subterfugere,reddita autem serenitate,euellere atque deiicere.Suffragiis è ciuitate eiectus,eiusq; dignitate ac nimiis opibus depressis,grauis fortuna inimico patriæ supplicë esse coegit.Nec tamen,iussus à rege Persarum,ad quë desciuerat, Græcis bellû inferre,ira in ciues suos eum cöcitare potuit: nec maximi honores atque opes ad patriam bello lacessendam impulerunt:fortasse quidë ratus opus maius quàm vt à se confici posset,præclaris tum ducibus abundâte Græcia, præsertim Cimone.Itaque fertur epoto taurino sanguine,venenóque infuso,in Magnesia diem obiisse,annos natus 65.Plutarc. in Themisto. Thucy. li. 1. huius etiam Themistoclis meminit Eras. in apophth.li.5.&8.

STESILEA, eleganti forma mulier,amata fuit ab Aristi-de ac Themistocle:inde fortasse cöflato liuore,perpetuo flagrarunt inter se odio:quâquam vitæ ac morum dissimilitudo,non parum auxisse odium dicatur: nam Aristidë cöntraria in repub. sententia aduersarium semper habuit Themistocles. Vide Plu-tar.in Themistocle.

page.notes: The two Greek legends on the medallions are read from the scan; the Greek on the left medallion (ΑΘΗΝΑΙΟΣ ΘΕΜΙΣΤΟΚΛΗΣ) is partly curved and could be checked. The right medallion legend reads STESILEA in Latin letters. Greek and Latin headings are not set apart from the text: the entry names run into the first line of each paragraph, so they are kept as paragraphs.
